extracted.name: Mojito
extracted.description: Recipe video above. The world's most refreshing cocktail, ever!! Made for hot summer days, but truthfully we make Mojitos year round just because we love the fresh minty flavour! SCALE RECIPE using slider.
ingredient_lines: 60 ml / 2 oz white rum ((I use Bicardi, Note 2))
instruction_lines: Place lime juice, rum and sugar syrup in tall glass. Use a muddler (Note 4) to bruise the mint to release flavour.
Fill glass with ice, pour over rum and soda water, then stir.
Garnish with lime slice and mint leaves. Serve immediately!
